ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, several small clusters with tight bud texture and some stems, slightly glossy and moist, sitting at upper left of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 3 cm tall | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale cream-white cubes of firm, crisp-looking fruit or vegetable, cut into roughly 1.5 cm chunks with flat cut faces, slightly translucent edges, lightly moist, grouped at lower left of the plate next to the broccoli | 75
ITEM 3 | Breaded light-golden coating on pieces of sliced meat or fish, with crumb texture and a few darker browned spots, cut into strips about 6 cm long and 2 cm thick, sitting at upper right of the plate, some green herb or leaf visible tucked between pieces | 130
ITEM 4 | Yellow-orange slices with darker charred edges and grill marks, dark green herb or sauce streaks across them, soft and slightly glossy, about 7 cm long, lying at lower right next to the cubed item | 60
ITEM 5 | Dark green leafy herb or spinach-like garnish with glossy wet sheen, scattered in small pieces between the breaded pieces and the grilled slices | 10
